Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.
Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

In your journeys throughout the Blasted Lands, should you ever come across a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, take the item back to Kum'isha the Collector.
Be warned, this gem is one of the most rare crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.
You will be rewarded for each Flawless Draenethyst Sphere you have collected.
Find and return a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum'isha the Collector.
Retrieve the Warchief's Orders and return them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Return to the Searing Gorge and find Dorius's archaeology unit.
Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.
Bring the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera's Dragonflight or not.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.
Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.
Collect 11 Silvery Claws and 1 Irontree Heart for Eridan Bluewind in Felwood.
Bring 15 Blood Amber to Arathandris Silversky in Felwood.
Bring 15 Blood Amber to Maybess Riverbreeze in Felwood.
Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.
Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Bring 2 Un'Goro Gorilla Pelts, 2 Un'Goro Stomper Pelts, and 2 Un'Goro Thunderer Pelts to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.
Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.

name_en: A Little Help From My Friends
objectives_text:
Lead Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
If Ringo faints, use Spraggle's Canteen to revive him.
Find Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge.
Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.
Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.

Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in Azshara.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
Find Pamela Redpath.

Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
Find Pamela's doll.
Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.
Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.
Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.
Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.
Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.
Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.
Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.
The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.

Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.
Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.
Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.
Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.
Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.
Return the Beast Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
You obtained a Warsong Mark of Honor for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.
Return the Portals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Return the Warlords Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Return the Elementals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.
Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.

Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.
Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.
Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
Oralius wants 50 Blackrock Medallions. Chances are high that these medallions can be found on the orcs in the Burning Steppes.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.
Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.
Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to kill 15 Raging Owlbeasts and 15 Ragged Owlbeasts.
Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
Slay 10 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.
Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.
Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.
Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.
Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.
Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
Find Carlin Redpath.
Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.
Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.
Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.
Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

name_en: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
objectives_text: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.
Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.
Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits. These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption. Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.
Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Find Ranshalla in eastern Winterspring.

Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity. Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

Free nine Servants of Razelikh, three Servants of Sevine, three Servants of Allistarj, and three Servants of Grol. Return to the Fallen Hero when your task is complete. You must remain within close proximity of the stones or the process will fail.
Open the chest and claim your reward.
Speak to Corporal Thund Splithoof.
Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the border of the Blasted Lands and the swamp.
Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
Listen to Loramus Thalipedes tell his story.
Defend Captain Vanessa Beltis, her crew and the Horizon Scout's passengers against the naga attack. Captain Vanessa Beltis must survive.
Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.
Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.
Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.
Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.
Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.
Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
Look for information about cooking Sandworm Meat at the Twilight's Hammer camp west of Cenarion Hold.
Bring the Torn Recipe Page to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold.
Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.
Collect 2 Pristine Yeti Horns for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
Find out what became of Lieutenant Kirith.
Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.
Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara. Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.
Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.
Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.

Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits.
Return to Loramus when the task is complete.
Take the Shipment to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.
Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.
Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.

Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.
You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.
When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information.
Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.
Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.
Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.
Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:
Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.
Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.
Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

name_en: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
objectives_text:
Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.
By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.
Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.
Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.
Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.
Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.
Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.
Speak with Yeh'kinya.
Speak with Molthor in Stranglethorn.
Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.
Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.
Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.
The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.
Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.
Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.
Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.
Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 10 Berserk Owlbeasts in Winterspring.
Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.
Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.

Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.
Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.
Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.
Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.
Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.
Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.
Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!
Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

name_en: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
objectives_text: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.
Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts
Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Return your ward to the Stormwind orphanage by handing in the Human Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Nightingale in the Cathedral District.
Use the Orcish Orphan Whistle to talk with the child you will be looking after during Children's Week.
Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Travel to Theramore to see about getting Lady Jaina Proudmoore's autograph for your ward.
Take your ward to the docks of Ratchet in the Barrens.
Take your ward to the Mor'shan Rampart in the northern part of the Barrens, just before entering Ashenvale.
Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule and Foror's brand ice cream.
Travel to Thunder Bluff to see about getting Cairne Bloodhoof's hoofprint for your ward.
Collect 4 Frostmaul Shards for Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.
Speak to Witch Doctor Mau'ari again in a moment to receive the lucky charm.
Speak with Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Vale off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
Use the Human Orphan Whistle to talk with the child you will be looking after during Children's Week.
Take the orphan to the bank of Darnassus. The bank itself is hollowed out of a tree known as the Bough of the Eternals.
Take the orphan to the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan. You should take him to the middle of the dam so he can see out over the giant waterfall.
Toss three Forsaken Stink Bombs into the heart of Southshore in Hillsbrad, and return to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade.
Locate the Forsaken's Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade. Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore once you've done so.
Take the orphan to see the lighthouse off the coast of Westfall.
Take your ward to the old Lordaeron Throne Room that lies just before descending into the Undercity.
Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde with your findings.
Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in Azshara.

Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj.
Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They cannot be killed otherwise - but use them wisely...

Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.
Return to Thrall!
Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.
Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.
It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!
Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.
Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

name_en: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
objectives_text: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.
Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
Get some Strawberry Ice Cream for your ward. The lad seems to prefer Tigule and Foror's brand ice cream.

In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.
Collect 5 Shardtooth Meats and 5 Chillwind Meats for Rivern Frostwind in Winterspring.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.
Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
Bring Storm Shadowhoof's Marker to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread. 
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.

In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow.
You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!
Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.
Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.
Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.
Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.
Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
5 Skin of Shadow.
Rivern Frostwind wants you to slay 5 Winterfall Shaman and 5 Winterfall Ursa.
Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.
Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.
Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.
Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.
Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov.
Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.
Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.
Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.
Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
Return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by handing in the Orcish Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Battlewail in the Valley of Honor.
Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Lightspark at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Hasana at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.
Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus.
Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears.
Defeat Redpath the Corrupted.
Speak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.
Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
Destroy Araj the Summoner and bring Araj's Scarab to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.
Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.
Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.
Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quatermaster in Frostwolf Keep.
Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.
Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
Rivern Frostwind wants you to kill 4 Frostmaul Giants and 4 Frostmaul Preservers.
Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

name_en: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
objectives_text:
Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.
Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.
Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.
Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.
Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.
Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.
Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.
Keep your wits about you, $N. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.
Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.
Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!
You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.
You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.
Listen to Thrall.
Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.
Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.
Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.
Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

name_en: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core
Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core
Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather
Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain

objectives_text: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
Speak with Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar about the Feast of Winter Veil.
Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.
Speak with Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

Locate a Frostwolf in Alterac Valley. Use the Frostwolf Muzzle when you are near the Frostwolf to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Frostwolf will follow you back to the Frostwolf Stable Master. Speak with the Frostwolf Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.
null

Locate an Alterac Ram in Alterac Valley. Use the Stormpike Training Collar when you are near the Alterac Ram to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Alterac Ram will follow you back to the Stable Master. Speak with the Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.
Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.
Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.
Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.
Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.
Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.
Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.
Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.
Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.

According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.
Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in the Dun Baldar garrison.
Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.
Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.
